_methodology.flights: Per person, return, London to Funchal (FNC). Built from live search-engine averages (Aug 2026) - sources disagreed slightly on the single cheapest month (Jan/Nov/Dec variously cited) so this table reflects the consensus shape: cheap Nov-Feb (outside the New Year spike), rising through spring, peak Jul-Aug, easing Sep-Oct. Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH.
_methodology.airbnbNote: Per night, whole-place rate for a group of 8 (one villa/large house, not per room). Madeira's Airbnb market skews heavily toward high-end villas in search results (many luxury 4-5 bed pool villas at $1,000+/night) - the figures below target a realistic mid-range 4-bedroom villa for 8, not the luxury end. Confidence: MEDIUM - worth pulling a few real mid-range listings to sanity check before finalizing.
_methodology.decemberNote: December is inflated relative to the general winter-low pattern because of Funchal's famous New Year's Eve fireworks display, which drives a genuine demand spike for both flights and villas in the last week of the month specifically - the rest of December is otherwise cheap.
